notes: AI was run only on faults whose classic PODEM result code was TIMEOUT under a 10 second timeout.
AI backtracks are benchmark diagnostic backtracks from the AI-guided PODEM path and are not a direct semantic replacement for classic PODEM backtracks.
AI shard logs reported reconvergence pair cache load failures (Ran out of input), so the run recomputed reconvergence data rather than relying on that cache.
